video_title: Jaylin Williams and the squad take over Media Day 🎥

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.text: With media day, it is my fifth season, fifth media day. I am excited for it. I think everybody is excited for media day, being back around each other. I am super excited. But I got my rookie here, B. Going to have a great year. Miss you guys. See you guys very soon. Let's do it.
quotes.pull_quote: I am excited for it. I think everybody is excited for media day
quotes.news_angle: Kenrich Williams expresses excitement for his fifth season with the Oklahoma City Thunder.
quotes.social_post: Kenrich Williams is ready for his fifth season with the Thunder. He says he is excited for media day and being back around the team.
